name: read_toric_and_current

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import re,subprocess,sys
p=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(Path.cwd()/'sources/toric.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert p.returncode==0
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/toric.txt'],input=p.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
s=p.stdout; print('TORIC DEFINITIONS',s[:16000]);print('TORIC CONJECTURES',s[-15500:])
s=Path('sources/mathdb-trees.html').read_text();print('CHALLENGE',[(w,s.lower().find(w)) for w in ['challenge-platform','cf-chl-','verify you are human']]);print('CURRENT RECORD TEXT',re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',s)[-14500:])
